**Highest‑grossing movie of all time (worldwide)**  
> **“Avatar” (2009) – directed by James Cameron**

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Worldwide box‑office revenue | ≈ $2.97 billion USD* |
| Domestic (U.S./Canada) | ≈ $760 million USD |
| International | ≈ $2.21 billion USD |

\*These figures include the 2010–2011 U.K. re‑release and the 2021–22 theatrical re‑run that pushed *Avatar* back above *Avengers: Endgame*.  

### Quick comparison

| Rank | Film | Year | Gross (USD) |
|------|------|------|-------------|
| 1 | *Avatar* | 2009 | ~\$2.97 bn |
| 2 | *Avengers: Endgame* | 2019 | ~\$2.78 bn |
| 3 | *Titanic* | 1997 | ~\$2.19 bn |
| … | ... | ... | ... |

*(All amounts adjusted for inflation only if noted.)*

So, as of now, “Avatar” holds the record for the highest total earnings at the cinema gates across the globe.
